sources.purpose: Attestation among the country's resident population, not a claim of national linguistic origin; no incidence estimates used as selection weights.
Pinned Latin-script national surname list, source ordering retained after documented de-duplication/exclusions. Redistribution rights not established; data are research-only.

Native Turkish Latin orthography: source-recorded ç, ğ, ı, İ, ö, ş, ü preserved. Excluded obvious diacritic-lossy forms instead of fabricating corrections; source licensing and individual variants require further review.

sources.romanization: Source-recorded native Turkish Latin letters, including ç ğ ı İ ö ş ü, preserved from uppercase via Turkish locale lower/title casing. Accentless equivalents discarded, not fabricated. Selection remains uniform; observed frequencies only qualify source attestation, never stored as weights.
